what: /larch:pause depends on ISSUE_NUMBER in current-design-env but the plan does not make issue-number rehydration mandatory after Step 0b binds the issue
scenario_or_breakage: The new pause skill sources current-design-env-$PPID.sh and treats unset ISSUE_NUMBER as no live session, so a normal /design run can never be paused even after the issue is known
suggested_fix: Add a required Step 0b writer refresh immediately after issue binding using write-design-current-env.sh --issue-number "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --claude-pid "$PPID", and cover it in the pause harness

what: Planned top-of-step sentinels under .completed invert the existing completion contract
scenario_or_breakage: Pause during an in-flight step marks that step complete before its artifacts exist, so design-pause-save computes the next step and resume skips required work
suggested_fix: Keep .completed for after-success completion only; use a separate .entered or .current-step sentinel for observability, and compute resume from registry-ordered completed sentinels

what: Planned git archive extraction restores the log directory path, not the design tmpdir contents
scenario_or_breakage: Load extracts larch-logs/design/<RUN_ID>/... under the fresh DESIGN_TMPDIR, leaving expected files like plan.txt and run-params.json missing at tmpdir root
suggested_fix: Archive from branch:larch-logs/design/<RUN_ID>/ or extract with the correct --strip-components count, then assert required restored files before LOAD_OK=true

what: The pause idempotency plan handles only existing local branches, not existing remote pause branches or open PRs
scenario_or_breakage: After a pause publish reaches RECOVERY_BRANCH because merge is blocked, a later pause of the same RUN_ID recreates a local branch from origin/default and push fails against the existing remote branch
suggested_fix: For --reason pause, explicitly update the existing remote branch with --force-with-lease or detect and reuse/update the open PR; preserve recovery output when the remote update fails

what: New pause helpers do not thread --repo through issue and publish operations
scenario_or_breakage: Forked or nested sessions can read/write the pause marker or publish logs against the gh hub default instead of the issue repository
suggested_fix: Add --repo to design-pause-save.sh and design-pause-load.sh, pass it through to named-block-write.sh, gh issue view, and design-log-publish.sh, and have SKILL.md resolve REPO before pause save/load

what: Empty-content delete semantics conflict with the promised bit-for-bit plan-block-write wrapper contract
scenario_or_breakage: Current plan-block-write.sh replaces a present block with empty inner content and emits MODE=replaced, but delegating to named-block-write would remove the larch:plan block and emit MODE=removed
suggested_fix: Make deletion explicit, for example --delete, or have plan-block-write.sh pass a compatibility flag that preserves empty-content replacement and the existing MODE set

what: Generic --marker is not specified as validated before being embedded in regexes and HTML marker literals
scenario_or_breakage: A future caller can pass marker text with regex metacharacters, whitespace, or larch namespace punctuation and corrupt block classification or issue-body marker structure
suggested_fix: Validate marker names against a strict allowlist such as ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ and fail before any gh calls; keep the documented marker registry in sync
